description: Motor Vehicle Registration Data by Energy Source :2016 -Present is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA. Motor Vehicle Registration Data by Energy Source:2016 -Present Vehicle types are compatible with FHWA Highway Statistics VM-1 "Total" counts of vehicles for a year are compatible with FHWA Highway Statistics MV-1 minus "Motorcycle." Motorcycle data are not included. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 4 columns, among them Counts, FuelType, VehicleType, Year. The portal shows 2026-02-02 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
